deploybot: Tag created: v3.4.3
- tag: v3.4.3
- commit: ab12c3d4
- target envs: staging -> canary -> prod
Changelog (high level):
• fix: reduce KV cache memory leak on long-lived sessions
• feat: routing fallback for low-capacity zones
• perf: improved batching heuristics for short prompts
Compare: https://git.company/redwood/infra/compare/ab12c3d4..v3.4.3
Command used: git tag -a v3.4.3 ab12c3d4 -m 'release v3.4.3'

Dina: Can we hold prod rollout until tomorrow 10:30 PT? QA saw a minor regression in embeddings for long contexts.
Sam: @dina acknowledged. We can hold prod; what's the canary plan?
Dina: Canary plan: eu-west-1 30m @5%, us-west-1 30m @10%, then us-east-1 40m @50%. If error rate > 1.2% or 95th latency +20% -> rollback.
Jordan: Requesting a pin for routing-service consumers that still need v3.4.2 compatibility. Need 24h window.
Sam: I'll create a service-level pin scoped to routing-service in prod for 24h.
opsbot: Pin created: routing-service@prod pinned to v3.4.2 until 1719219956 (24h). ID: pin-7821
Mike: Rollback plan (ops runbook):
```
# rollback to last stable
./scripts/ops-deploy rollback --env=prod --tag=v3.4.2 --reason=\'canary-failure\'
# verify
curl -sS https://ops-api/health | jq .status
```
deploybot: Canary rollout started in eu-west-1 at 2024-06-01T15:10:56Z. Traffic: 5%. Monitoring: https://console.redwood/monitoring/canary/1234
Dina: Noted. QA will run the regression suite during the eu-west window.
Sam: Thx — I'll update the release notes with the pin info and the hold. Ping me if we need to accelerate.
deploybot: Can confirm: tag v3.4.3 published to registry and container digest pushed (sha256:9f4c8e3b...).
